test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B together can complete a work in 15 days. If A, B and C working together can complete the same work in 10 days, then in how many days can C alone complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A and B to complete the work = 15 days

Time taken by A, B and C to complete the work = 10 days

**Calculation:**

Work done by A and B in one day = 1over15 

Work done by A, B and C in one day = 1over10

Work done by C in one day = 1over10 - 1over15 = 1over30

∴ Time taken by C to complete the work = 30 days

**C can complete the work in 30 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**LCM of 10 and 15 = 30

Let the total work be 30 units

Efficiency of A and B = 30 ÷ 15 = 2 units 

Efficiency of A, B and C = 30 ÷ 10 = 3 units

Efficiency of C = 3 - 2 = 1 unit

Time taken by C = 30 ÷ 1 = 30 days
